summary: Institutional positioning is overwhelmingly bullish on the long-term trajectory of the S&P 500, evidenced by massive call buying in SPX with a heavily skewed 0.21 P/C ratio. Significant directional conviction is seen in the accumulation of SPX 6000C and 7000C strikes for 2026 and 2027, totaling billions in premium, alongside aggressive single-day call buying in semiconductor names like AMD ($162.4M) and MU ($271.9M). Persistent multi-day interest is concentrated in the SPX 6000C (exp 2026-06-18) and 7000C (exp 2026-06-18) positions, which have seen over $12 billion in cumulative accumulation over the last four sessions. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in the semi-sector (AMD, MU) and monitor SPX for any volatility spikes that might test the massive long-call liquidity sitting at the 6000 and 7000 levels.
